General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Fuel Filler Gas Cap for the Geo Tracker & Suzuki Sidekick.
It works on all models from 1989 thru 1998.
It is Self Venting and has a built-in Twist/Torque Limiter to prevent over tightening that could restrict air flow into the tank.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Gas Cap
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
